answer: The island schedule is applied in basalt and haven shows each instalment. A payout is split which means 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1469 identities would post 3267 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
